paras: Application: Toyota GR Supra A90 / A91 (2020+) Part Type: Auxiliary (port injection) fuel pump hanger Part Number: 20-0760

The Radium 20-0760 Fuel Pump Hanger adds one independent 39mm fuel pump to the MK5 GR Supra for an auxiliary fuel supply such as port injection, while leaving the OEM direct injection fuel system completely intact. The OEM pump, regulator, pre- and post-pump filters, collector basket, venturi jet pump and fuel level sensor all stay in place, and no fuel tank modifications are required.
hl: OEM System Retained: OEM direct injection pump, regulator, filters, collector basket, jet pump and level sensor all remain
Pump Outlet: 8AN ORB female port with a preinstalled low-profile 8AN male banjo
Return Inlet: 8AN ORB female port with a preinstalled low-profile 6AN male banjo and internal deflector
DI Feed: OEM direct injection pump outlet uses an SAE quick connect
Electrical: High-current stainless studs, hermetically sealed, with anodised aluminium acorn nuts; ETFE-insulated in-tank wiring
Compatible Pumps: Walbro GSS342 (255 LPH), AEM 50-1200 E85, TI Automotive BKS1001 (brushless), Injector Dynamics ID BPC-1100 (brushless)
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Pump Hanger for Toyota GR Supra A90 / A91 2019+
